lead: Debashree Roy is an Indian actor, born on 8 August 1961 in Kolkata.
As of 2026, she is 65 years old, and her birth date places her under the Leo sign.
She has 42 credited works on public record and has held the office of Member of the 15th West Bengal Legislative Assembly and Member of the 16th West Bengal Legislative Assembly.
